claims.claim: The core of the role is Python backend work with LangGraph, which matches Python and LangGraph in resume.key_skills.
claims.quote: Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway.
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: Building agentic flows with LangChain and LangGraph matches LangChain and LangGraph in resume.key_skills.
claims.quote: Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry.
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The required LLM application framework experience matches LLM and LangGraph in resume.key_skills, and the role aligns with resume.target_roles (AI Engineer, LLM Platform Engineer).
claims.quote: Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses.
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The role is fully remote, which fits resume.location_preference.open_to_remote, though location eligibility restrictions may apply.
claims.quote: All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements.
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The role is Intermediate level, which is a stretch for resume.years_of_experience of 1.

claims.contradicted_by: Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement.

claims.claim: The posting expects production Python backend experience including APIs and async processing, which resume.key_skills does not explicitly show beyond Python and SQL.
claims.quote: Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models.
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The posting does not mention visa sponsorship, so it is uncertain whether it meets resume.visa_sponsorship_needed.
claims.label: insufficient

results.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Factory: Code Security

claims.claim: The role is a senior-level position, which does not fit resume.years_of_experience of 1 year.
claims.quote: Senior Software Engineer, Security Factory: Code Security
claims.label: contradicted
claims.contradicted_by: Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement.

claims.claim: The posting requires substantial production experience in Go and/or Rust. resume.key_skills lists neither language and centers on Python.
claims.quote: Substantial professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Go and/or Rust, with depth in at least one.
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The posting requires demonstrated application security experience. resume.key_skills contains no security, vulnerability research, or CWE/OWASP skills.
claims.quote: Demonstrated application security experience, such as vulnerability research, secure code review, or writing detection rules, and fluency with vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, CWE) and the software supply chain
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: Experience building LLM tooling and evaluations partially matches the LLM, LangChain and LangGraph entries in resume.key_skills.
claims.quote: Experience building your own LLM tooling, such as a harness, an agent pipeline, or evaluations, with the judgment to know when output is trustworthy and when it isn't
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: Python is used for some analyzers, which overlaps with Python in resume.key_skills, though it is secondary to Go/Rust.
claims.quote: We use both, plus Ruby on the remediation side and Python for some analyzers, and value willingness to work across them.
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The role is remote, which suits resume.location_preference.open_to_remote.
claims.quote: Remote-Global
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The posting does not mention visa sponsorship, so it is unclear whether resume.visa_sponsorship_needed can be accommodated.
claims.label: insufficient

claims.claim: The title is a backend security engineering role rather than one of the resume.target_roles (AI Engineer, ML Engineer, LLM Platform Engineer), although it does include AI-driven analyzer work.
claims.quote: As a Senior Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Security team, you help developers find and fix security issues.
claims.label: supported

results.title: Software Engineer, Security Business Enablement

claims.claim: The core work is building a production RAG/LLM platform. This directly matches the RAG, LLM, LangChain and vector databases skills in resume.key_skills and the AI Engineer / LLM Platform Engineer resume.target_roles.
claims.quote: Comfort working with retrieval-augmented architectures, content pipelines, and AI/LLM integrations, or demonstrated ability to learn quickly in these areas
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The preferred qualifications explicitly name RAG systems, which aligns with RAG in resume.key_skills.
claims.quote: Experience building AI-driven products or workflows, particularly retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems or knowledge management platforms
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The posting asks for evaluation and measurement of retrieval quality, which fits the MLflow and SQL experience in resume.key_skills.
claims.quote: Experience building evaluation frameworks for AI systems, such as measuring retrieval quality, answer accuracy, or coverage gaps
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The posting accepts any programming language, so Python from resume.key_skills is sufficient.
claims.quote: Strong coding skills in any programming language
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The minimum of 2+ years exceeds resume.years_of_experience of 1. This is a real gap that makes the role a stretch.
claims.quote: 2+ years of software engineering experience building production systems
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The title is a general Software Engineer role in a security team rather than an explicitly AI/ML titled role, so it only partially matches resume.target_roles.
claims.quote: Software Engineer, Security Business Enablement
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: Preferred cloud security and compliance experience is not reflected in resume.key_skills, but these are bonus qualifications.
claims.quote: Previous experience with security software engineering, compliance tooling, or GRC platforms
claims.label: supported

claims.claim: The posting does not state a location, remote policy or visa sponsorship. Fit with resume.location_preference (Boston, open to remote) and resume.visa_sponsorship_needed is therefore unverified.
claims.label: insufficient
